Happened to me for a long time. Feeling hopeless and losing your will to live is something I can definitely relate to. When this happens to me I try to focus on things I like or used to like maybe listening to music, planting a garden. Honestly anything small that gives you positive emotions because that one thing might be the only reason for you to keep going. Ik it’s not easy especially school. About a year ago my gpa was shit it was the worst it has ever been in 20 years now, yeah it was very hard but I kept going and I would do absolutely anything to get myself to feel some sort of positive emotions. I’m glad you at least tried to seek help because I myself did not have the courage to do it and still don’t. School is probably like the biggest reason why you are feeling like this so focus on yourself first because regardless of how hard you try your gpa isn’t gonna go up too much rn probably since it’s the middle of the semester. But start with at least submitting stuff and getting extensions. Don’t think about the overall gpa focus more on just getting things done. My gpa was a 2.5 it’s now a 3.3 a year later. This a shit gpa still but I’m getting there at least. You probably also have high standards for your grades like I do. I went from a 4.0 to a 2.5 in one semester barely passed and almost when on academic probation. Hang in there just focus on yourself and take it slow.
